svg.aria-label: Logical clocks compared. A Lamport clock is one counter per node; it gives a total order that respects causality but cannot tell whether two events were concurrent. A hybrid logical clock combines physical time with a Lamport-style counter, so timestamps stay close to wall-clock time while never going backwards, used by CockroachDB. A vector clock keeps one counter per node and can detect concurrency, at the cost of size that grows with the number of nodes.
